jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. HVAC Technician – JLL

What this job involves: JLL is seeking a skilled HVAC Technician to join our established operations and maintenance team at a premier facility in Atlanta, GA. This is a rare opportunity to work at a single, stationary location—no driving between sites or customers. You'll report to the same building every day, working alongside a dedicated team that values continuous improvement, cross-training, and collaborative problem-solving. Our team members have tenure ranging from 7 to 30 years, creating a stable environment with exceptional historical knowledge and strong customer relationships. As part of our proactive, team-oriented culture, you'll maintain and troubleshoot critical HVAC systems including boilers, chillers, cooling towers, and building automation systems while contributing to a workplace that prioritizes quality, professional growth, and operational excellence.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Conduct regular tours and inspections of HVAC equipment and building systems as specified in contract requirements and management directives.
• Respond to service calls, perform diagnostic troubleshooting, and execute minor to major repairs on chillers, boilers, VAV systems, cooling towers, pumps, motors, fans, and related equipment.
• Review and adjust building automation systems (BAS) to optimize HVAC performance and maintain environmental comfort standards.
• Perform comprehensive preventive maintenance including filter changes, coil cleaning, condenser flushing, tube punching, bearing lubrication, belt inspection and adjustment, motor bearing replacement, and pulley/shaft alignment..
• Monitor and maintain water chemical treatment systems for condensers, chilled water, heating water, and secondary water loops, including associated feed equipment
• Execute facility repairs on building components including walls, flooring, ceiling tiles, painting, and plumbing fixtures (water closets, urinals, flush valves, lavatories).
• Collaborate with team members on complex troubleshooting challenges and participate in continuous cross-training on various equipment types and systems.

Required Qualifications:

• Minimum 2-5 years of hands-on experience working with commercial HVAC systems, including chillers, boilers, cooling towers, and VAV systems.
• Must be a current member of Local 99-99A AFL-CIO union or eligible to join within 90 days of employment.
• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot equipment issues independently and think creatively to solve complex mechanical problems.
• Strong team collaboration skills with willingness to cross-train on diverse equipment and building automation platforms.
• Physical capability to perform maintenance tasks including climbing, lifting, and working in mechanical spaces.
• Commitment to following safety protocols, manufacturer recommendations, and industry best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Technical trade school training or HVAC certification programs (on-the-job experience also valued).
• This position is represented by Local 926. You'll need to be a current union member or be able to join the union within your first 90 days on the job.
• Experience with building automation systems (BAS) review and programming adjustments.
• Knowledge of water chemical treatment monitoring and maintenance procedures.
• Familiarity with preventive maintenance documentation and scheduling systems.
• Basic facility maintenance skills including minor carpentry, painting, and plumbing repairs.
• Experience working in union environments or understanding of union workplace practices.

Location: Atlanta, GA

Work Shift: Day shift (stationary single-site location)

Compensation & Benefits:

• Union Position: Local 99-99A AFL-CIO

Comprehensive Benefits Package:

• Full family medical insurance coverage paid by employer through union (no cost to employee).
• Union pension contributions: $7.85 per hour worked deposited into individual pension fund.
• Paid vacation and sick leave.
• 11 paid holidays annually.
• Scheduled annual wage increases.
• Overtime opportunities available for additional income.

Note: Openings at this site are infrequent. This is an excellent opportunity to join a stable, long-tenured team at a premier facility.

The engineer will manage multiple projects and collaborate with global engineering, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, logistics, suppliers, and other stakeholders to deliver packaging solutions that protect products, support efficient transportation, and meet business requirements. GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. Support packaging requirements for New Product Introduction (NPI), product transfers, Variable Cost Productivity (VCP), safety, sustainability, and packaging improvement projects. Evaluate packaging performance and identify opportunities to improve product protection, safety, cost, sustainability, and supply chain efficiency. Support both local and global packaging initiatives and work effectively with stakeholders across the US, Europe, China, and other regions. Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$85,600.00 - $141,200.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic team player to join our Strategic Resolution Group Claim team as a Technical Specialist handling complex toxic tort, latent injury, sexual misconduct and/or environmental claims that may present significant financial exposures. With general supervision, you will manage moderate to large exposure claims with complex liability and coverage issues, with the goal of developing strategies to ensure that claims are successfully resolved in the most efficient and effective way while meeting established protocols and delivering optimal customer service. As you meet the challenges of an ever-changing litigation landscape, you will maintain and develop a strong understanding of applicable law in multiple jurisdictions enhancing your ability to successfully manage complex coverage and liability issues.

What Will You Do?

• In the handling of moderate to large exposure claims, your responsibilities may include:
• Coverage Research and Analysis - Responsible for researching the existence of policies that may have been issued by multiple legacy companies and analyzing coverage. Apply knowledge of relevant legal concepts in applicable jurisdictions. Prepare coverage recommendation and reviews with management where applicable. Effectively communicate coverage positions to policyholders or their representatives.
• Liability Investigation and Analysis - Conduct thorough investigation and analysis of claim facts to determine liability. Acquire and apply knowledge of relevant evolving legal concepts and claim types in jurisdiction to evaluate damages and develop recommendation for appropriate course of action. Is aware of and applies knowledge of emerging litigation trends.
• Litigation Management - Proactively develop and execute a strategic file management plan that achieves optimal file resolution, including as appropriate research and recommendation of counsel; litigation and resolution strategies; management of loss adjustment expenses; engagement of appropriate experts; use of proper settlement and release terms. Attend meetings with counsel, settlement conferences, mediations and trials.
• Account Management – Develop and apply an in-depth knowledge and understanding of newly, mature accounts in actions and decisions. Maintain effective working relationships with other account contacts. Ensure claims and settlement agreements are handled in a consistent manner. Responsible for regular communication and reporting to coordinate / align actions on assigned accounts.
• Financial Analysis - Estimate financial exposures on an individual claim and account basis. Develop budgets and financial analyses in consultation with supervisor and maintain appropriate defense and indemnity estimates.
• File Maintenance and Administrative Compliance - Maintain well-documented and organized claim files. Maintain proficiency with SRG claim systems and databases. Adhere to applicable requirements for data accuracy. Efficiently manage file inventory.
• Staff Development - May be involved in training, mentoring and interviewing.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

• Education & Work Experience:
• Bachelor’s degree.
• 3+ years of experience in claim handling, legal, insurance or coverage advice or environmental fields.
• Job specific or technical competencies:
• Analytical Thinking.
• Communication.
• Judgment & Decision-Making.
• Teamwork.
• Accountability.
• Customer Focus.
• Relationship Management.
• Business Perspective.
• Knowledge of Regulatory and Claim Environments.
• Planning & Organizing.
• Technology.
• Working Independently.
• Application of Departmental Practices and Procedures.
• Licensing.

What is a Must Have?

• High School Diploma or GED.
• 2 years experience in claim handling, legal, insurance, coverage advice or environmental fields.
• In order to perform the essential functions of this job, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) may be required to comply with state and Travelers requirements. Generally, license(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the job.

What Is in It for You?

• Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
• Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
• Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
• Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
• Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.
